name: After § 28
title: REPORT on general guidelines for the preparation of the 2027 budget, Section III – Commission
part_text: 28a. Rejects any political instrumentalisation of rule-of-law conditionality leading to the withholding of funds from a Member State because it pursues policies aimed at protecting its borders and defending the family; considers that defending family values and protecting one’s people against illegal immigration, insecurity and the social tensions it generates should, on the contrary, be regarded as a fundamental right and become a shared objective of the EU; expresses concern that, at the same time, substantial funds are being allocated to certain third countries, while the EU is considering enlargement towards countries where the manifest absence of the rule of law does not appear to raise any concerns;
